record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.context_brief: minimal fractional Sobolev energy at fixed degree
record.original_question: For 1 < p < infinity and d in Z, let m_{p,d} be the infimum of the p-th W^{1/p,p} seminorm among maps f in W^{1/p,p}(S^1; S^1) with degree d. Is m_{p,d} = |d| m_{p,1} for all integers d, and is the infimum defining m_{p,d} achieved? If this linear formula fails, is there an explicit formula for lim_{d->infinity} m_{p,d}/d, equivalently inf_{d>0} m_{p,d}/d?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 5.4 ([26, Open Problems 22 and 23]). Let 1 < p < infinity. Is it true that m_{p,d} = |d| m_{p,1} for all d in Z? Is the infimum in (5.6) achieved?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $1 < p < \infty$ and identify $S^1$ with the unit circle in $\mathbb{R}^2$ (equivalently with $\mathbb{R}/2\pi\mathbb{Z}$). For a measurable map $f \colon S^1 \to S^1$, define the Gagliardo $W^{1/p,p}$-seminorm
$$[f]_{W^{1/p,p}(S^1;S^1)}^p \;=\; \int_{S^1}\!\!\int_{S^1} \frac{|f(x)-f(y)|^p}{|x-y|^{2}}\,dx\,dy,$$
and let $W^{1/p,p}(S^1;S^1)$ be the space of measurable maps with finite seminorm taking values almost everywhere in $S^1$. Each $f \in W^{1/p,p}(S^1;S^1)$ has a well-defined integer topological degree $\deg(f) \in \mathbb{Z}$. For $d \in \mathbb{Z}$, set
$$m_{p,d} \;=\; \inf\!\Big\{ [f]_{W^{1/p,p}(S^1;S^1)}^p \,:\, f \in W^{1/p,p}(S^1;S^1),\ \deg(f)=d \Big\}.$$

(a) Is it true that $m_{p,d} = |d|\, m_{p,1}$ for every $d \in \mathbb{Z}$?

(b) Is the infimum defining $m_{p,d}$ achieved (for every $d \in \mathbb{Z}\setminus\{0\}$)?

(c) If the identity in (a) fails, is there an explicit formula for
$$\lim_{d\to\infty}\frac{m_{p,d}}{d} \;=\; \inf_{d>0}\frac{m_{p,d}}{d}\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is stated as an open problem in works of Brezis and collaborators on fractional Sobolev maps between manifolds (e.g. in surveys on $W^{1/p,p}(S^1;S^1)$ and degree). No publication located in the search resolves whether $m_{p,d}=|d|m_{p,1}$ for all $d$, nor whether the infimum is achieved; related questions about additivity of fractional energies under degree are reported as unresolved.

status_evidence.title: A surprising formula for Sobolev norms and related topics
status_evidence.snippet: Open problems posed by Brezis on fractional Sobolev seminorms of maps between manifolds, including questions about minimization at fixed degree.
status_evidence.claim: The question of whether $m_{p,d}=|d| m_{p,1}$ and whether the minimum is attained is listed among Brezis's open problems on $W^{1/p,p}$ maps.

status_evidence.title: Fractional Sobolev norms and BV functions on manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of $W^{s,p}$ seminorms of $S^1$-valued maps and degree, with open questions about minimal energy in a given homotopy class.
status_evidence.claim: Recent research on fractional Sobolev maps still treats the minimal $W^{1/p,p}$-energy at fixed degree on $S^1$ as an unresolved problem.
